title: Efficient synthesis of tetrazoles via [2 + 3] cycloaddition reaction catalyzed by cobalt–nickel on magnetic mesoporous hollow spheres
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,18535-18547
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02982A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Maryam Ansari, Amir Hossein Ghasemi, Hossein Naeimi
This study presents a magnetic Co–Ni/Fe3O4@mesoporous silica hollow sphere nanocomposite (Co–Ni/Fe3O4@MMSHS) as an effective nanocatalyst for synthesizing tetrazoles from aromatic nitriles and sodium azide via [2 + 3] cycloaddition.
